description: Mailchimp offers a Marketing API that provides programmatic access to its data and functionality for managing audiences, campaigns, and more.

evidence.claim: The Mailchimp Marketing API provides programmatic access to Mailchimp data and functionality for managing audiences, campaigns, and more.
Developers can obtain an API key after creating a Mailchimp account, enabling self‑serve access.
OAuth 2 authentication is supported for accessing Mailchimp Marketing API data on behalf of other users.
API key authentication is supported for the Marketing API when accessing one’s own Mailchimp account.
Mailchimp also offers a single‑purpose Export API version 1.0.
The API provides a broad set of capabilities including audience management, campaign analytics, webhooks, e‑commerce integration, batch operations, and a mobile SDK.
Developers can build integrations using the Marketing API and OAuth 2, indicating the platform is buildable.
